audit.whatIsWrong: Key Ability Interactions described Infernal Chains (W) as a root; Riot’s text says enemies are dragged back to the centre if they do not leave the zone, and the decisive interaction for this matchup was absent.
audit.why: Thundering Blow (E in Hammer, 20/18/16/14/12) knocks you back and is how he escapes your commit; the R form swap is an auto reset, so the swap animation is the burst tell. Acceleration Gate boosts his Shock Blast — respect the gated Q.
audit.corrected: Your Q sweetspot (outer edge) is your damage and your heal — land the edge, never the inner hit, and use E mid-cast to swing the sweetspot onto Jayce. Infernal Chains (W) drags him back to the centre if he doesn't leave the zone — hold it for the moment he swaps to Hammer to escape. Thundering Blow (E, 20s at rank 1) knocks you out of your Q pattern, so bait it. Vs his poke save E to close the gap, not for chip, and dodge a gated Shock Blast — it travels faster through his gate.
